purpose: Same independent NOA-05 reviewer, corrected-source acceptance after sequential F1/F2 corrections; historical request-changes artifact unchanged
rawHashNote: Hashes identify original omitted inputs, not curated archive bytes. Paths are repo-relative historical scratch locations and are not required archive prerequisites.
archiveHashNote: Keys are relative to this bundle and hash curated archive bytes after formatting/final report edits. This provenance file is excluded to avoid self-reference. Content checksums are not external attestations.

archiveTransformations.README.md: New bundle index, final verdict and reproduction limits
archiveTransformations.review.md: New corrected-source independent review and refreshed matrix, preserving historical blocked evidence by link
archiveTransformations.gate-results.json: Both runner JSON records normalized into common command templates and ordered timing/exit rows; <TMPDIR> expands from each attempt
archiveTransformations.v1-summary.json: Curated final reporter JSON: shared test prefix and per-file passed counts; redundant assertions/case stacks omitted
archiveTransformations.root-test-summary.json: Both raw-log invocation summaries compacted into explicit-column rows; default test inventory, duration and failure/todo limits added from inspected scripts/logs
archiveTransformations.remediation-review.json: Semantic copy of initial independent minimal-delta/hash reconciliation, including inspected owner red-result summary; not an old-source reviewer test rerun
archiveTransformations.admission-observations.json: Independent public-entry JSON plus sanitized historical asserts-bug error and maintained-case interpretation; scratch executable omitted
archiveTransformations.socket-resolution.json: Curated initial required failure counts/paths, independent long/short Node socket observations and complete successful rerun resolution
archiveTransformations.source-identity.json: Curated complete-worktree before/after identity, selected hashes, comparable earlier source scope and protected historical bundle hashes; full map omitted
archiveTransformations.content-audit.json: Semantic copy of refreshed spelling inventory totals and migration block preservation summary

omitted: raw logs and detailed reporter JSON
full source manifests, source snapshot and complete diff
scratch runners, probes and audit tooling
dependency trees, generated consumers, builds/dist, tarballs and release staging
databases, caches, browser assets and machine-local runtime data
reproducibility: Summary-only, not self-contained. Curated invocation/per-file counts can be reconciled; full raw outcomes and source identity cannot be reconstructed from the archive alone. Commands need a matching checkout, dependencies and applicable MongoDB/registry/cache/browser support, plus a short ignored checkout-local TMPDIR. No clean-HEAD baseline or optional beyond-default matrix is claimed.
